text./* Energiefluss-Linie (SVG im HTML-Widge: /* Energy flow line (SVG in HTML widget) */ .gh-flow{ stroke-dasharray:2 14; stroke-linecap:round; animation:gh-flow 1.2s linear infinite; } /* Reverse direction, e.g. grid import instead of feed-in */ .gh-flow.rev{animation-direction:reverse} @keyframes gh-flow{to{stroke-dashoffset:-16}} /* Battery as liquid: set --soc via binding */ .gh-liquid{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:30px} .gh-liquid::before{ content:"";position:absolute;left:50%; width:420px;height:420px;margin-left:-210px; top:calc(100% - var(--soc,50) * 1% - 8px); border-radius:42%;background:#3a8452; animation:gh-wave 9s linear infinite; } @keyframes gh-wave{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ .gh-flow,.gh-liquid::before{animation:none!important} }
text./* Pumpenrad dreht nur bei laufender Pum: /* Impeller only spins while the pump is running */ .gh-spin svg{animation:gh-spin 1.4s linear infinite} @keyframes gh-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ .gh-spin svg{animation:none!important} }
